description: Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets. We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together. Role description: This role will form an integral part of our Global Excellence Centre (GEC) – Arcadis’ centralized and fully integrated project delivery group. Our GEC is made up of more than 3,000 talented individuals working in offices across Romania, India and Philippines, providing Capability, Capacity and a Competitive Advantage across a wide array of unique projects and services, in collaboration with our global businesses. The MEPF Discipline (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, and Fire Protection) in the GECs is comprised of cross-functional teams, that contribute to the development of innovative MEPF solutions that optimize energy efficiency, sustainability, and occupant comfort. Our ability to effectively manage projects, assess client needs, and provide technical guidance is crucial in delivering successful outcomes, using the most innovative way of doing computational design. Role accountabilities: Conducts engineering design of ventilation, heating and colling installations under the supervision of an experienced engineer. Conducts engineering design of water distribution (cold, hot, industrial, etc), wastewater distribution and rainwater distribution under the supervision of an experienced engineer. Conducts engineering design of general lighting, emergency lighting, power distribution (up to 1kV), fire signaling systems, burglary and CCTV systems, under the supervision of an experienced engineer. Designs, calculates, sketches, 3D modeling, diagrams, schematic drawings, and final working drawings under the supervision of an experienced engineer. Build proficiency in REVIT and other software used in the design process. Performs the tasks within the agreed-upon budget and schedule. Prepare reports and presentations as directed by senior engineers. Follow company standards and procedures including design and checking. Preparing all the necessary drawings for the specific phase of projects (report, 2D plans, schematics, sections). Qualifications & Experience: Mandatory: Bachelor’s degree in building services. Good knowledge of design software (e.g. AutoCAD) and calculation software, specific for each discipline. Minimum of 1 year experience in HVAC engineering is required. Strong English language skills. Eager to learn new capabilities and skills. Good understanding of norms and standards related to HVAC. Candidate to show problem solving skills, creativity, to show proactivity and analytical skills. Good planning, organizational, and communication skills are necessary for success in this position. To show interest in personal and professional growth, in a challenging, rewarding, and competitive professional environment. To be able to perform his/her own quality check and to be conscious around safety in design principles. Nice to have: Master’s degree in building services. Basic knowledge of Revit MEP. Basic knowledge of electrical specialized software (Revit, EPLAN, Amtech, Intelec, etc.). Basic knowledge of mechanical (building services) specialized software (Revit, HAP, Design Builder etc.). Participation in internships for AEC companies. Candidate to show out-of-the box thinking in order to identify any opportunities for automation or innovation. Key attributes: Professional approach to time, costs, and deadlines. Capable of working withing a team. Has a supportive attitude. Proactive in asking questions. Good communication skills, both verbal and written. Why Arcadis? We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together. You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you. Together, we can create a lasting legacy. Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy. Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day, which is why we take equality and inclusion seriously and hold ourselves to account for our actions. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people. #GECPlacesDesign&Engineering #GECPlacesRomania #GECPlacesIndia

description: **Location**: 100% Remote from India, min. 4h overlap with CET (e.g. 9:00–13:00 CET). Fluent English, spoken and written. German is not required. **Compensation**: 20k-32k USD per year (depending on location) + Shares + Generous Benefits. We pay local rates that are at or above the market. We share this [philosophy with GitLab](https://about.gitlab.com/blog/2019/02/28/why-we-pay-local-rates/). **About Secfix** Secfix automates security compliance for SMBs and mid-market companies in Europe and gets them compliant with ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX and SOC 2 in weeks instead of months. We’re a fast-growing team of 36 people, backed by a $12M Series A from Alstin Capital, Neosfer (Commerzbank) and Bayern Capital. **About the Role** You’ll be the **first engineer dedicated to our go-to-market team**. You build and own the backend systems our BDRs and AEs run on every day: data pipelines, integrations, internal services and AI agents. Today, everyone runs their own setup for data, outreach and communication. You’ll replace that with one central, reliable system that scales with us. This is a hands-on engineering role: you’ll write code (Python, SQL) every day, connect APIs and build data pipelines and AI workflows, not configure tools or run RevOps. You report to our Head of GTM, work closely with Sales and exchange with our Engineering team on architecture and best practices. We own products and outcomes, not Jira tickets. **What You'll Do** - **Data pipelines:** Design and build pipelines that pull account and contact data from multiple sources and APIs, clean, deduplicate and score it, and sync it to our CRM as the single source of truth. - **Data layer:** Design the data model and central database behind our GTM, connecting CRM, outreach and product data. - **Integrations & services:** Integrate internal and third-party tools via REST APIs and webhooks, and build small internal services and tools where off-the-shelf tools fall short. - **Signals & automation:** Build signal detection, lead scoring and routing, and alerts that tell the right rep which account to call today and why. - **AI agents:** Build AI-powered tools and agents that take repetitive work off our AEs, from research to proposals to CRM updates. - **Reliability:** Deploy, schedule, monitor and maintain everything you build: error handling, retries, rate limits, logging and alerts when something breaks. - **Ownership end-to-end:** Investigate problems, find the root cause, ship the fix and document it so nothing depends on one person. Your success: reps spend less time on manual work and more time with customers, and more pipeline comes from systems that run reliably and are actually used. **About You** You’re a backend engineer who loves building things real people use every day, and curious about the business: why a customer buys, which signal means a company is ready. You build systems that run reliably at 10x volume, not one-off scripts. - Recent graduate (0–2 years) in Computer Science or a related engineering field with a strong academic record. - 1+ years of backend experience through your first full-time job or internships in a startup environment. - Strong engineering fundamentals: solid Python (or another backend language), SQL and data modeling. - Experience building and consuming REST APIs and working with webhooks. - You know how to run code in production: Git, deployment, scheduling, testing, logging and debugging. - You think in systems: you understand how components depend on each other and what breaks when you change one part. - Hands-on experience with AI coding tools and LLM APIs (e.g. Claude Code or the Claude API). - You’ve built and shipped real things (a feature, service, data pipeline or internal tool) and can show them. - Smart, structured problem solver and fast learner: you pick up new tools on your own and bring complexity down. - Independent, proactive and comfortable communicating remotely, especially in writing. **Nice to have:** Experience with a cloud platform (AWS or GCP), a data warehouse, a CRM and its API, or GTM tools like Clay. You **should not apply** if: - You need detailed tickets telling you what to build. - You only want to write code and don’t care about business impact. - You don’t want to test, monitor and maintain what you ship. - You’d rather be led than lead your own projects. - You don’t want to work closely with Sales and the people who use your tools. **Interview Process** - ~30 min – Introductory call with our Talent team - Technical take home challenge (~8–10h, 7 days to submit) - ~90 min – Interview incl. live coding with our Head of GTM - Final interview with our co-founder and Head of GTM **What we offer** - **Remote Work:** 100% remote work with a virtual office in Gather. - **Competitive Salary:** Industry-competitive local salaries. We pay local rates that are at or above the market. We share this [philosophy with GitLab](https://about.gitlab.com/blog/2019/02/28/why-we-pay-local-rates/). - **Equity:** Generous equity package – we’re all owners of Secfix and beneficiaries of our collective success. - **Holidays**: 26 days holiday + local public holidays. - **Health Insurance:** Comprehensive health coverage. - **Development Budget:** €1,000 annual personal development budget. - **Workspace Budget:** Remote workspace budget and access to co-working spaces. - **Annual Retreat**: Annual retreat to build connections and inspire ideas (this year we’re headed to Alicante, Spain!). - **Tech Equipment**: Latest tech equipment (MacBook, monitors, headphones). - **Company Events:** Company-wide events to build relationships and have some fun! - **Mentorship:** We are backed by top VCs and accelerators and have direct access to world-class mentors. Our values: we are obsessed with our customers, we build smart, we create trust, we are hacky, we take ownership, and we are leaders of remote. *We are an equal-opportunity employer and remote-only company. We work in sync using Gather as our virtual office and therefore cannot support 100% asynchronous work.* [*Read more about our Remote Culture here*](https://app.notion.com/p/Remote-Culture-93bf571583904c5e814b7afd83c240f2?pvs=21)*.*

title: Custom Software Engineer - Salesforce Data 360
description: As a Salesforce Data 360 Developer, you will configure, build, and support customer data solutions on Salesforce Data Cloud (Data 360). You will contribute as a senior developer, working on data ingestion, data modeling, identity resolution, data transformations, calculated insights, and segmentation, working closely with architects and business teams to deliver implementations aligned with business requirements. Responsibilities: Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs. Configure and maintain data streams from Salesforce (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Marketing Cloud) and external systems. Build and maintain Data Model Objects (DMOs), configure Identity Resolution rules, develop Data Transforms, and write and optimize SQL for Calculated Insights. Create and test segments for downstream activation. Debug issues related to missing data, incorrect unification, or data mismatches. Support UAT, deployment, and post-go-live production issues. Work with architects and analysts to implement technical designs. Participate in code reviews, testing, and release cycles. Support defect resolution and optimization activities. Document Data 360 configurations and technical flows. Requirements: Hands-on experience with Salesforce Data Cloud (Data 360) configuration and development. Solid understanding of Data Streams and DMOs, Identity Resolution and Match Rules, Data Transforms, Calculated Insights (SQL), and Segmentation and Activation. Ability to develop maintainable and scalable solutions. Strong problem-solving and communication skills. Strong SQL skills (joins, aggregations, and window functions preferred). Experience working with JSON, APIs, and data integration pipelines. Understanding of event-based data and customer engagement tracking. Basic understanding of Salesforce metadata, objects, and permissions. Good-to-have skills: Sales Cloud / Service Cloud knowledge. Exposure to Zero Copy, Document AI, or Semantic Layer is a plus. Knowledge of Salesforce Agentforce integrated with Data Cloud (Data 360) to enable real-time, data-driven AI agent experiences. Certifications Required: Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant Mandatory, Salesforce Administrator Mandatory, Agentforce Specialist Preferred, Salesforce AI Associate Preferred. Additional Information: 3.5 years of Salesforce experience. 1 year of experience in Data 360 implementation projects is preferred. Experience working in Agile teams. 15 years of full-time education is required.

ai_summary.why: Strong SQL and Java skills with 2 years of production experience, matching the core technical requirements.
ai_summary.gaps: Missing Salesforce Data Cloud certification and specific experience with Salesforce Data 360.

description: **About Us** Valiance is a global AI & Data analytics firm helping clients build cutting-edge technology solutions for digital transformation. We work with some of the marquee brands across India, US and APAC to build transformative solutions for Credit Risk, Fraud, Predictive Maintenance, Quality Inspection, Data lake, IOT analytics etc. Our team comprises 120+ professionals across Machine Learning, Data Engineering & Cloud expertise. As a Generative AI Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and implementing cutting-edge generative AI models to solve complex problems. You will work closely with various stakeholders to design, build, and deploy AI-powered solutions that enhance ABG products and services. **Key Roles and Responsibilities** 1. Define, build and deploy enterprise focused Generative AI solutions on Microsoft Azure cloud services. 2. Comfortable working in the cloud and high-performance computing environments -Azure/ GCP. 3. Utilize off-the-shelf Azure (OpenAI) services, to integrate LLM capabilities into applications, and collaborate with the business and IT teams. 4. Create, Modify and deploying code libraries, accelerators (GitHub) programming languages such as Python, R. 5. Build Rapid prototypes and do proof of concepts (PoC) in one or all the following areas: LLM, NLP, DL (Deep Learning), ML (Machine Learning), object detection / classification, tracking, etc. 6. Apply prompt-engineering techniques to specific use cases and types of models. 7. Stay informed about the latest advancements in Gen AI, machine learning, and AI technologies to optimize our technical stack. 8. Co-ordinate for Tech Support and Continuous improvements **Skills required** 1. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in generative AI and experience working with LLM (Large Language Models) in particular. 2. 2-3yrs experience with AI technology and Azure cloud services, Cognitive services (AI, ML, LLM, algorithm), Python, NLP, Generative AI. 3. Strong understanding of Open AI (Chat GPT, GPT, Chatbot) 4. Better understanding on fine-tuning with Azure OpenAI distributed OpenAI models such as DaVinci, curie, Babbage, ADA. 5. You are proficient in Python and have experience with various machine learning libraries and frameworks with necessary Azure cloud experience of configurations, troubleshooting etc. 6. Good communication skills and basic customer mgmt.

title: AI Fullstack Engineer
snippet: Driven by why, powered by patterns
description: Responsibilities: Design and ship full-stack AI features end-to-end, from the user-facing surface to the services and agent runtimes behind them. Build and operate agent harnesses (tool use, planning, memory, eval loops, guardrails) that reason over long, complex contracts and the varied document types around them. Own retrieval and context systems for high volumes of complex documents: chunking, embeddings, vector indexes, hybrid search, re-ranking, and citation-grounded generation. Take prototypes to production: observability, evaluation, regression suites, latency and cost budgets, prompt and model version management. Drive system-design decisions across services, data stores, model providers, and infrastructure. Use coding agents fluently as a daily driver to ship more, faster, without losing quality. Requirements: 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, with 1-2+ years shipping generative AI applications to production. Strong front-end (Next.js / TypeScript) and Python back-end skills, with a solid grasp of system design. Working knowledge of LLM fundamentals and a clear-eyed view of their limitations and failure modes. Has shipped at least one RAG system or agent to production, and built the agent harness around it (orchestration, tools, evals, observability). Hands-on experience with an agent framework (LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or similar), or has built their own agent runtime/harness and can clearly justify why it beats reaching for a framework. Production experience with a major cloud (AWS / GCP / Azure), a relational database (Postgres preferred), and object storage. Fluent daily use of coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar). Even Better If: Experience with model evaluation tooling (Braintrust, LangSmith, Arize, Phoenix, LangFuse). Background in a compliance-heavy or regulated domain, working with sensitive data (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA-style regimes) and the engineering practices that come with it. Open-source contributions of any kind.

description: About This Role Your team Modern Workplace Engineering delivers and operates enterprise workplace technologies that enable secure and reliable access across managed devices. The team engineers and supports enterprise mobile services, with a strong focus on Apple iOS and iPadOS and hands-on ownership across Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) and Microsoft Intune. The team partners across security, identity, network, application and service-management functions to improve platform reliability, automation and the overall mobile experience. Your role and impact As an Associate in Modern Workplace Engineering, you will be an individual contributor responsible for delivering mobile-platform engineering and operational improvements from design through production support. You will help evolve enterprise mobile services by strengthening device-management capabilities, improving automation, resolving complex technical issues and supporting secure integration with identity, networking and adjacent platforms. iOS and iPadOS engineering will be the primary technical focus, with macOS and Jamf experience contributing to broader Apple-platform capabilities. The role combines engineering delivery with steady-state service ownership and cross-functional collaboration. Your responsibilities Responsibilities In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities: Engineer and operate enterprise mobile management services across Ivanti EPMM and Microsoft Intune, including enrollment, configuration, compliance, application management, testing, controlled releases, platform standards and technical documentation. Own the mobile-platform service lifecycle, delivering engineering backlog items and Level 3 troubleshooting while supporting controlled environments, incident and problem management, knowledge transfer and reliable day-to-day operations. Develop secure, supportable automation and reporting using PowerShell and other appropriate scripting, application programming interface (API) and source-control capabilities to reduce manual effort, improve data quality and increase visibility of platform health and performance. Lead iOS and iPadOS engineering and contribute to broader Apple-platform capabilities, including device enrollment, managed applications, certificates, macOS and Jamf collaboration, automation and lifecycle standards. Partner across security, identity, network, application and service-management teams to deliver secure and resilient mobile services, manage dependencies and communicate technical risks, decisions and status to stakeholders. Your experience Demonstrated experience in enterprise endpoint, mobility or modern workplace engineering, including hands-on enterprise mobile management and strong iOS and iPadOS engineering capabilities. Experience engineering enterprise device enrollment, configuration, compliance, managed applications, reporting and device lifecycle processes. Practical experience with scripting, automation, APIs and controlled source-management practices, including PowerShell and relevant experience with Python, shell scripting, Git or Azure DevOps. Strong Apple enterprise-management experience, with iOS and iPadOS as the primary focus and additional macOS or Jamf experience beneficial. Understanding of enterprise identity, certificate, network and secure-access technologies and their integration with endpoint-management services, including Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI). Strong troubleshooting, engineering ownership, documentation and communication capabilities in complex enterprise environments, with experience supporting service improvements or significant platform changes beneficial. Experience with enterprise automation, service-management, security or operational-reporting platforms is beneficial, as is experience in regulated environments and relevant endpoint-management certifications. Our Benefits To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about. Our hybrid work model BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock. Guidance on AI use for candidates At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
